title: Narrate a post
subtitle: A synthetic voice reads your written post out, and you publish it as an audio post that links back to it.
proHint: More voices, music and time with Pro

entry.title: Read this post out as an audio post

gate.signIn: Sign in to narrate your posts.
gate.notOpen: Narration is not open for your account yet.

pick.title: Pick your text
pick.empty: You have no posts yet. Write one here.

write.placeholder: Write your post. Focus mode is in the tools below.
write.hint: The post is published on Hive first, then you can narrate it.
write.published: Your post is out. Now make the narration.
write.missing: Add a title and some text first.

script.title: The script
script.hint: This is what the voice reads: pictures, links and emoji are already gone. Edit it as you like. An empty line starts a new paragraph, a line starting with # is read as a heading.
script.tooLong: longer than the {{left}} you have left today
script.nothing: There is nothing to read in this post. Try another one, or write the script yourself.

music.title: Background music
music.proNote: The music library and your own music come with 3Speak Pro.
music.credit: The song is credited in your post, as its licence asks.
music.ownHint: Music you have the rights to, at most 15 minutes. It loops under the voice, well below it.

make.title: Make the recording
make.introHint: The voice starts with the title, your name and that a synthetic voice reads it.

publish.addLink: Add a Listen link to your written post
publish.linked: Your written post links to the audio now.

errors.dailyLimit: That is longer than your narration time left today ({{left}}). Shorten the script or come back tomorrow.
errors.publishFailed: Publishing did not work, try again.
